statBlock.name: Gargoyle
statBlock.description: A creature of living stone lies in wait on roofs and cliffs, where it passes for a carved ornament.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine.
sections.Traits:
False Appearance. While motionless, it looks exactly like an inanimate statue.
Elemental Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 140. Resistance wording follows the official errata.

statBlock.name: Griffon
statBlock.description: This eagle-lion hunter nests on high cliffs and favors horses as prey. An expert can raise one from an egg as a mount.

sections.Traits: Keen Sight. The griffon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use sight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Beak attack and one Claws attack.
Beak. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

statBlock.name: Treant
statBlock.description: This awakened tree defends its forest. It often stands rooted for long stretches, watching for anything that threatens the grove.

sections.Traits:
False Appearance. While motionless, it looks exactly like an ordinary tree.
Siege Monster. It deals double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +10 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. Hit 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Animate Trees (1/day). Magically animate one or two trees it can see within 60 ft. Each acts as its ally and keeps the treant's statistics with three changes. Its Intelligence and Charisma are both 1, it cannot speak, and Slam is its only listed action option. A tree stays animated for up to 1 day. The effect ends early if the tree dies, if the treant dies or gets more than 120 ft. away, or if the treant uses a bonus action to turn it back into an ordinary tree. It then takes root if possible.

statBlock.name: Tribal Warrior
statBlock.description: A spear fighter who relies on fighting alongside allies. The profile can fit fighters from many kinds of communities.

sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The warrior has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if an ally is within 5 ft. of that creature and the ally is not Incapacitated.
sections.Actions: Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage with a two-handed melee attack.

statBlock.name: Unicorn
statBlock.description: A celestial guardian with an ivory horn and healing magic. It typically protects a forest or another place held sacred.

sections.Traits:
Charge. It must move at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hit that target with Horn on the same turn. The hit then deals an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must pass a DC 15 Strength save or fall Prone.
Magic Resistance. The unicorn has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma, spell save DC 14. No components.
At will. Detect Evil and Good, Druidcraft, Pass without Trace.
1/day each. Calm Emotions, Dispel Evil and Good, Entangle.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Hooves attack and one Horn attack.
Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Horn. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Healing Touch (3/day). Touch another creature with the horn. That creature magically regains 11 (2d8 + 2) HP, loses all diseases, and has all poisons affecting it neutralized.
Teleport (1/day). Move magically to a familiar location up to 1 mile away. The unicorn can take up to three willing creatures it sees within 5 ft. and all equipment the travelers wear or carry.
sections.Legendary actions:
The unicorn has 3 legendary actions. Use one option at the end of another creature's turn and regain spent actions at the start of its turn. It can skip an opportunity. It cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it cannot use them until after its first turn.
Hooves (1 action). Make one Hooves attack.
Shimmering Shield (2 actions). Place a magical shield on itself or another creature it can see within 60 ft. That creature gains +2 AC until the end of the unicorn's next turn.
Heal Self (3 actions). Magically regain 11 (2d8 + 2) HP.
sections.Lair: Its lair can be a quiet woodland site, such as an overgrown ruin, misty clearing, or flower-covered hill.
sections.Regional effects:
The DM can use any of these effects within the unicorn's domain. They end immediately if it dies.
Open nonmagical flames go out. Closed lanterns keep burning.
Creatures native to the domain have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide.
If one good-aligned creature uses a spell or magical effect to heal another good-aligned creature, the target regains the maximum possible HP for that spell or effect.
Curses on good-aligned creatures are suppressed.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 293–294. Legendary action timing follows p. 11 and the official errata.

statBlock.name: Minotaur Skeleton
statBlock.description: The animated bones of a minotaur retain the force of its charge and can still wield a greataxe.

sections.Traits:
Charge. It must move at least 10 ft. straight toward a target and hit that target with Gore on the same turn. The hit then deals an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, a failed DC 14 Strength save pushes it up to 10 ft. away and knocks it Prone.
Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Greataxe. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage.
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Warhorse Skeleton
statBlock.description: An animated warhorse skeleton still wears scraps of its barding.

sections.Traits: Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions: Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
